title: Turn 'Fast' into a Design Requirement
description: The prompt is 'design a fast notification service.' Before selecting a queue, what clarification most directly guides the architecture?

options.text: Ask which deliveries need seconds versus hours, what scope matters and whether loss or duplication is worse.
options.explanation: Measurable quality goals and explicit scope guide the acceptance boundary, retry policy and durability choices.

options.text: Choose the most popular broker so the requirements are implied.
options.explanation: A product name does not define the user's latency or correctness needs.

options.text: Enumerate every possible notification feature before agreeing on scope.
options.explanation: An unbounded feature list consumes the interview without identifying a manageable core.

options.text: List every database column before discussing behavior.
options.explanation: Detailed fields are less useful than knowing the required actions and guarantees.
